about_the_game:
The sound of cicadas in the scorching summer is deafening, and the air seems to carry the scent of conspiracy.

My assistant, Ashari, and I received an email from a mysterious employer, who calls themselves the "Snow White of the Clock Tower."
They offered a large sum to hire us to deal with a series of evil spirit serial killings in the city of Alann, a foreign city shrouded in mystery.

Night is falling, but the prey has yet to appear...
And our story will quietly unfold on the first evening we arrive in Alann.

"To You, Evil Spirit" is a visual novel game themed around suspense and romance. Players will take on the role of a "spirit detective" and, alongside their sassy assistant Ashari, travel to the overseas city of Alann to hunt down and eliminate the malicious chainsaw-wielding evil spirits.

The game is narrative-driven, where you read text and make key choices, experiencing the evolving relationships between characters and gradually uncovering the hidden truths behind the city.

✨ Game Features:

  • A carefully crafted original world and a fantasy city atmosphere blending multiple cultures

  • Two main characters, multiple branching story choices, and a single ending path

  • Beautiful character artwork and background music to create an immersive visual novel experience

🎮 Current Version (Demo):

  • Opening story: "The First Night" — The protagonist and Ashari's first encounter in Alann

  • Around 30,000 words of text, with an approximate reading time of 15 minutes

  • Implemented content: 2 main characters, multiple choices, a fixed storyline

The current version offers a complete prologue experience. Players will face key decisions that influence the story's direction and the interactions between characters, but the ending is fixed. Future updates may expand on the plot and character routes.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains partial nudity and mild violence. Viewer discretion is advised.
